αὐτάρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’
αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’ as direct object of a verb: ἤλασε δ’ αὐτόν ’struck him’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’ · also fem. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὴ δὲ χθαμαλὴ κεῖται ’and the island itself lies low’) · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (οἶδα καὶ αὐτή ’I know it myself’)
αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also intensive, accusative subject of an infinitive: ’she herself’ (αὐτὴν ποθέσαι ’that she herself miss [him]’) · also attributive, ’the same’: τῷ αὐτὴν ὁδὸν ’the very same road’ · also intensive with a noun, ’very’: εἰς ὁδὸν αὐτὴν ’into the very path’ · also intensive with a pronoun object, ’you yourself’ (σὲ … αὐτήν)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of the olive), governed by ἀγχόθι ’near’: ἀγχόθι δ’ αὐτῆς ’and near it’ · also intensive with a noun, fem. gen. sg.: αὐτῆς Ἰθάκης ’Ithaca itself’
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βάλ: βάλλω — throw, strike; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (βάλ’ = ἔβαλε): ’struck’
βίας: βία — force, violence; fem. acc. pl.: ‘acts of violence’
βροτοῖσι: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
βροτὸν: βροτός — mortal; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with ἄνδρα ’a mortal man’)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένετο: γίγνομαι — become, be born, happen; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγένετο)
γέροντα: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. sg.
γέροντι: γέρων — old man; masc. dat. sg.
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γενεὴν: γενεή — generation, race; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
γούνασι: γόνυ — knee; dat. pl., epic γούνασι (= Attic γόνασι)
γυναικὶ: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. dat. sg.
γόῳ: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. dat. sg.: ’with wailing’
δάκρυον: δάκρυον — tear; neut. acc. sg., by-form of δάκρυ
δέμας: δέμας — bodily form, frame; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in body’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
διαρραίσουσι: διαρραίω — break in pieces, destroy utterly; fut. 3 pl.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’)
δμώων: δμώς — slave, bondman (esp. war-captive); masc. gen. pl.
δουλιχίῳ: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island near Ithaca (exact location unknown); dat. sg.
δυσμενέες: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; used substantivally, ’enemies’; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενεῖς)
δυσμόρῳ: δύσμορος — ill-fated, unlucky; masc. dat. sg.
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῆμος: δῆμος — people, community; masc. nom. sg.
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰκοστῷ: εἰκοστός — twentieth; ordinal adj., masc./neut. dat. sg. (ἤματι εἰκοστῷ ’on the twentieth day’)
εἰλήλουθα: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθα): ’I have come’
εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic form (unaccented after an accented word): ’I am’
εἰμὶ: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg. (grave, mid-clause form): ’I am’
εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω, ’say, speak’) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., standing for an imperative: ’go and tell’ · also aor. inf. dependent on an adjective or wish, ’to tell’ (ποτιφωνήεις … εἰπεῖν ’able to tell’)
εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’ · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may there be (for us)’ (εἴη μὲν νῦν νῶϊν … ἐδωδὴ ’may there be food for us two’)
εἴσ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., elided (εἴσ’ = εἰσί): ’there are’
εἴφ: εἶπον — say, tell (pres. ἐρῶ, φημί); aor. imper. 2 sg., elided with aspiration before a rough breathing (εἴφ’ = εἰπέ)
εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took up (for herself)’ · also with ἐκ in tmesis: ’took away from’ (ἐκ … εἵλετο)
εἵματ: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl., elided (εἵματ’ = εἵματα)
εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
εὔμαιε: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. voc. sg.
ζακύνθῳ: Ζάκυνθος — Zacynthus, an island near Ithaca; dat. sg.
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θέλγει: θέλγω — enchant, bewitch, beguile; pres. 3 sg.
θείη: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might make’ (σκέδασιν θείη ’make a scattering’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with an infinitive: ’may (Zeus) grant (that I come)’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
θεός: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg. · also fem. nom. sg. ’goddess’ (δεινὴ θεός; θεός is common gender)
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender) · also nom. sg. subject, of a god already introduced by epithets but not yet named: ’the god’
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θᾶσσον: ταχύς — swift; comparative adv. θᾶσσον ’more swiftly, the sooner’
θῆκ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (θῆκ’ = θῆκε, = Attic ἔθηκε): ’set down’
κάτα: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc., placed after its noun with anastrophe: κραναὴν Ἰθάκην κάτα ’throughout rocky Ithaca’ · also standing after its verb, not after a noun: ἔχῃ κάτα δῆμον ἅπαντα ’holds throughout the whole land’ (κατά + acc., or tmesis for κατέχῃ)
κίε: κίω — go, go one’s way; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist, unaugmented): ’went’ (the gen. Τηλεμάχοιο is governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’, not by this verb) · also imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
κακά: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl., substantive: ’evils, troubles’ (πάθομεν κακά ’we suffered troubles’)
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl.
καλῇ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. dat. sg.
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
κατάλεξον: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order (not yet ’choose’, as later); aor. imper. 2 sg.
κείνη: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); fem. nom. sg.
κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’)
κεχαρισμένα: χαρίζομαι — oblige, gratify; perf. part. pass. neut. acc. pl., used as an adj.: ’agreeable, kindly’
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’) · also pres. 3 sg. of a living person in a settled, ongoing state, not of the dead nor of an outcome nor of stored goods (ὁ μὲν ἐν νήσῳ κεῖται ’πάσχων’): ’remains, is stranded, dwells on’ · also of a place, ’lies, is situated’ (νῆσος ... κεῖται ’an island lies’) · also of an object: ’lies’ (ἀράχνια κεῖται ἔχουσα ’lies holding cobwebs’)
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κλισίην: κλισίη — seat, chair (general sense); fem. acc. sg. · also hut, shelter (the usual epic sense): ’to my hut’ (ἐς κλισίην ἄγαγον ’I led you to my hut’)
κλισίης: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic κλισία)
κοιρανέουσι: κοιρανέω — rule, lord it over; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κοιρανοῦσι)
κραναὴν: κραναός — rocky, rugged; fem. acc. sg.
κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
κρύβδην: κρύβδην — secretly, in secret; adv. (cf. κρύπτω)
κύσε: κυνέω — kiss; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκυσε)
κὰδ: κατά (apocope κάδ before δ-) — down through, throughout; prep./preverb in tmesis: ’throughout the halls’ (κὰδ δώματα = κατὰ δώματα) · also a bare preverb in tmesis with a verb: κὰδ ... ἔβαλε = κατέβαλε ’threw down’
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’
λίπεν: λείπω — leave, quit; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλιπε)
λαέρτην: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; acc. sg.
λαέρτῃ: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.
λαερτιάδη: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; voc. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. noun, not adverbial: κῦμα μέγ’ ’a great wave’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’)

μαρναμένοισι: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic μαρναμένοις)
μεγάλῃ: μέγας — great, big; fem. dat. sg.
μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεμαυῖα: μέμονα (perf. of μάω) — be eager, strive; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (masc. μεμαώς), ’eager’
μενέω: μένω — stay, remain, wait; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic μενῶ)
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’) · also + gen., ’among, in company with’ (μετ’ ἄλλων … ἑταίρων ’among your other companions’)

μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ)
μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj., companion to μή
μητέρ: μήτηρ — mother; acc. sg., elided (μητέρ’ = μητέρα)
μηχανόωνται: μηχανάομαι — contrive, devise, scheme; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -όωνται (= Attic -ῶνται): ’they contrive’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)

μοῦνον: μοῦνος — alone, single (epic = Attic μόνος); masc. acc. sg.: ’alone’
μυρίοι: μυρίος — countless, numberless; masc. nom. pl. (later ’ten thousand’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’
μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not a new one’, of a debt)
νέῳ: νέος — young, new; masc./neut. dat. sg.
νήσοισιν: νῆσος — island; dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
νεῖκος: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a quarrel (arises)’
νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
νόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνόησε): ’noticed’
νόστιμον: νόστιμος — of homecoming, of return; neut. acc. sg., in νόστιμον ἦμαρ ’day of return’
νόῳ: νόος — mind, thought; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’in mind, in thought’
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οἷσί: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic οἷς), accented before the enclitic περ; dat. after πέποιθε ’trusts in’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (= Attic οὗ) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. agreeing with a noun (οὗ πατρὸς ’her own father’s’)
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πάντεσσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πᾶσι)
πάροιθεν: πάροιθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also + gen., spatial: ’in front of, before’ (πάροιθεν Ὀδυσσῆος μεγάροιο ’in front of Odysseus’s hall’)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’)
πάσχεις: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. 2 sg.: ’you suffer’
πέποιθε: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθε, with present sense: trust, rely on (+ dat.); 3 sg.
παθὼν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
παρὲκ: παρέκ — out along, beyond, outside (+ gen.); prep., epic = παρά + ἐκ
πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περικλυτόν: περικλυτός — famed all round, far-renowned; neut. acc. sg.
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
πηνελοπείῃ: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope; dat. sg., dat. of comparison · also dat. sg., indirect object: ’to Penelope’ (ἐρέοντα περίφρονι Πηνελοπείῃ ’to tell prudent Penelope’)
πιέμεν: πίνω — drink; aor. inf. act., epic -εμεν (= Attic πιεῖν)
ποιῆσαι: ποιέω — make, do; aor. inf.: ’to make (an end)’
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom. pl. (agreeing with ἔγχεα): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of a verb: ’many things’ (παλαιά τε πολλά τε εἰδώς ’knowing many old things’) · also neut. acc. pl., adjectival with a noun: ’many’ (πολλά τε δῶρα ’and many gifts’)
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — many-devising; voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσέφης: προσφημί — speak to, address; impf. 2 sg. (the poet’s address to Eumaeus; the usual 3 sg. is προσέφη)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic by-form προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πρῶτόν: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’, accented before enclitic τοι
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόλινδ: πόλις — city; fem. acc. sg. with -δε suffix, elided (πόλινδ’ = πόλινδε): ’to the city’
πύλονδε: Πύλος — Pylos; + directional suffix -δε: ’to Pylos, Pylos-ward’
πύλου: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; gen. sg.
πῖνε: πίνω — drink; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’was drinking, drank’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’drink!’ (πῖνε, καὶ ἄλλα … μεμνώμεθα ’drink, and let us remember other things’)
σάμῃ: Σάμη — Same, an island near Ithaca; dat. sg.
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
σταθμοῖο: σταθμός — door-post, jamb (also stall, station, dwelling); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
στεναχίζω: στεναχίζω — groan, wail; pres. 1 sg., epic · also pres. subj. 1 sg., short-vowel, in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I may groan’
στυγερὸν: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. acc. sg.
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
συβῶτα: συβώτης — swineherd; masc. voc. sg., epic -α (in apposition to Εὔμαιε)
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by (+ gen.); adv. · also + dat.: σχεδὸν ἀλλήλῃσι ’close to one another’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῶς: σῶς — safe, sound; also ’sure, certain’; masc./fem. nom. sg.
σῷ: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic) · also article-like with ἄλλα, ’the other (things)’ (τά περ ἄλλα ’in the other matters’)
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’ · also in ἦ τέ, a strengthened affirmation: ’truly’ (ἦ τέ μ’ ἔφαντο ’who truly said’)
τέκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἔτεκεν)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταμίην: ταμίης — steward, dispenser (Attic ταμίας); masc. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελευτὴν: τελευτή — end, completion, conclusion; acc. sg. (τελευτὴν ποιῆσαι ’to bring to an end’)
τετυγμένα: τεύχω — make, fashion; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. pl.: ’wrought, well-made’, agreeing with ἄγγεα · also agreeing with δώματα: ’well-wrought’ (τετυγμένα δώματα ’well-wrought halls’)
τεός: τεός — your, yours (2nd person possessive adj., epic = σός); masc. nom. sg.
τηλέμαχ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., elided (Τηλέμαχ’ = Τηλέμαχε)
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιγὰρ: τοιγάρ — well then, accordingly; particle introducing a response to a request
τοιόσδε: τοιόσδε, -ήδε, -όνδε — such (as this); masc. nom. sg.
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’ · also τοι, the affirming particle (ἀλλ’ ἦ τοι ’but truly’), as the grave-accented form τοὶ
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj. · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: τοῖον … ἔρνος (acc.), τοῖον … δόρυ (nom.) ’such a shoot, such a trunk’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
τρύχουσι: τρύχω — wear out, exhaust, consume; pres. 3 pl.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόσσοι: τόσος — so many, so great; epic τόσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’so many’ (correlative with ὅσσοι)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον)
τῆος: τῆος — meanwhile, for so long; adv., epic (= Attic τέως), correlative of ἧος
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also predicate adjective: ’dear’ (φίλος ἦεν Ἰήσων ’Jason was dear (to her)’)
φαίνονται: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, show oneself; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’appear’
φαγέμεν: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. φαγεῖν; inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic φαγεῖν): ’to eat’
φασιν: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl.: ‘they say’
φθινύθουσιν: φθινύθω — waste, consume, cause to waste away (epic lengthened form of φθίνω); pres. 3 pl. transitive: ’waste, consume’
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
χρυσείῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’)
ἀγορεύσω: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; fut. 1 sg.
ἀγροὺς: ἀγρός — field, countryside; masc. acc. pl.
ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’unseemly things’ (ἀεικέα μερμηρίζων ’pondering unseemly things’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πήρην: ’unseemly, shabby (wallet)’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’shameful (deeds)’ (ἀεικέα ἔργ’)
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; acc. sg. · also the city Athens: εὐρυάγυιαν Ἀθήνην ’wide-streeted Athens’
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀθηναίης: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic-epic form (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
ἀληθείς: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; aor. part. (passive form) masc. nom. sg.: ’having wandered’
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’) · also with ὀστεόφιν, ’around’ (ἀμφ’ ὀστεόφιν θὶς ’a heap around the bones’)
ἀμφίπολον: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. acc. sg.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv.
ἀνώγοι: ἄνωγα — bid, command, urge; perf. with present sense, opt. 3 sg., epic
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπεχθόμενος: ἀπεχθάνομαι — be hateful, be hated, + dat.; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’being hateful’
ἀπόνητο: ἀπονίναμαι — have joy of, profit by; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἀπώνατο): ’had joy of’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρνεῖται: ἀρνέομαι — refuse, deny, say no to; pres. 3 sg.
ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω
ἀχνύμενοί: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες) · also = ἀνά as a preposition + acc.: ’up through, up among’ (ἂν δόνακας ’up through the reeds’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλγιον: ἄλγος — pain, grief; comparative adv. ἄλγιον used absolutely: ’an added grief, all the more painful’
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄττα: ἄττα — father; voc. sg., a respectful address by a younger man to an older one, carrying no kinship
ἐΐσκεις: ἐΐσκω — liken, make like; deem, suppose; pres. 2 sg.: ’you liken (yourself)’
ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; leave off, give up; fut. 1 pl., used hortatively: ’let us leave off’ · also with an object, ’we will let (him) be’ (τοῦτον μὲν ἐάσομεν)
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. 3 pl.: ’became, were’ (ὁμηγερέες ἐγένοντο ’were assembled together’) · also ’were born’ (ἠδ’ ἐγένοντο)
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
ἐθέλων: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘willing’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλεύσεται: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — come, go; fut. 3 sg. mid.
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form; agrees with τέκνον) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: οἶκον ἐμόν ’my house’
ἐμός: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναργεῖς: ἐναργής — visible, manifest, in bodily presence; masc. nom. pl.
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, devise, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’)
ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone to’
ἐπεμάσσατ: ἐπιμάσσομαι — touch, stroke; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπεμάσσατ’ = ἐπεμάσσατο)
ἐπικρατέουσιν: ἐπικρατέω — hold power over, rule; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦσιν), + dat.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐϋπλυνὲς: ἐϋπλυνής — well-washed; adj., neut. acc. sg., epic ἐϋ-
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἔδοντες: ἔδω — eat (epic, = Attic ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’eating’
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’placed’
ἔλθω: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. (ἦλθον) subj. 1 sg. ’I may go’
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
ἔοικας: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you are like’
ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like, resembles’ + dat. (θεοῖσιν ἔοικε ’he is like the gods’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic -εσι)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition/predicative, naming a maker: ἔργον Ἡφαίστοιο ’the work of Hephaestus’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a passive verb: ’work’ (τόδε ἔργον ἀέξεται ’this work grows’)
ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἔσομαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 sg., middle form
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε)
ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl.: ’they hold’
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἠμείβετο, elided ἠμείβετ’)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἡμέων: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; gen. pl. ’of us’, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡμῶν)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I have come’ · also aor. 3 pl. (the form serves both persons): ’they came’
ἤϊκτο: ἔοικα — be like, seem; plpf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔκει): ’she was like’ + dat.
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥβην: Ἥβη — Hebe, goddess of youth, wife of Heracles in heaven; fem. acc. sg. · also ἥβη — youth, prime of youth; fem. acc. sg.: ’youth’ (ἥβην πολυήρατον ’much-loved youth’)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with κὰδ in tmesis: ’let down’) · also of hurling a missile: ’hurled’ (ἧκε … κορυφὴν ὄρεος ’hurled the peak of a mountain’) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’put in’ (ἐν … ἧκε)
ἧσται: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 3 sg. (= Attic κάθηται): ’sits’
ἰδεῖν: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. inf.: ’to look upon’
ἰδυίῃ: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic εἰδυίᾳ): ’skilled, knowing’ + acc.
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἱρὰ: ἱερός (shortened ἱρός) — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacrifices’
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἴεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
ὀδυσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’)
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὁμοῖος: ὅμοιος — like, similar; masc. nom. sg., + dat.
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄρηται: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, arise; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., without ἄν/κε after εἰ
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο) · also + pres. indic., ’as, in whatever way’ (ὅπως ἐθέλεις ’as you wish’)
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’ (correlative with τόσσοι)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’) · also in an indirect question, ’what’ (ὅττι ἑ κήδοι ’what was troubling him’) · also conj. ’that, because’, introducing a clause (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’)
ὑλήεντι: ὑλήεις — wooded (from ὕλη); masc./neut. dat. sg.
ὑποδέγμενος: ὑποδέχομαι — receive, undergo; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (= ὑποδεξάμενος)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὑφορβός: ὑφορβός — swineherd (ὑπό + φέρβω ’feed’); masc. nom. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse, set in motion; aor. 3 sg.: ’stirred up, roused’
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ᾤχεο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go off; impf. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ᾤχου)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥάβδῳ: ῥάβδος — rod, wand; fem. dat. sg., instrumental
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
